title: D-h: planning accuracy, deal-stock landing and PM planning bias on Plan vs Executed (chartered, not built)
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation: .eif/audit/PROGRAMME_20260924/dh/RECOMMENDATION.md (D-h feature-definition moment, D-0019). Extends /plan-vs-executed; no new module
WAPE plan accuracy and unit-weighted signed bias per product_line x closed quarter tie out to a golden fixture and to W1-style recon for at least 2 quarters
Every bias figure carries quarters_n, lines_n and confidence (insufficient / indicative / established); thresholds are tenant config
Open quarters and lines with pipeline remaining are excluded from accuracy and shown as pending
B2 apply_bias refuses with a reason below the established threshold and exposes its source window
Malformed period labels and NULL product_line are counted and reported, never silently dropped
Landing rate uses POD / Arrived (N-0062) only and is labelled distinctly from A1-02 Over-plan intake
Person-level PM bias only when a person field is mapped; otherwise the UI says 'by business line'
COMMERCIAL_SEMANTICS section 4.1 updated in the same change (A1-10..A1-12)
Bias is a trusted signal only after N-0060 historical backfill or 8 closed quarters (~2027 Q1); Warren answers D-0026 first
